[package]
name = "loro"
version = "1.10.3"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/loro/"
description = "Loro is a high-performance CRDTs framework. Make your app collaborative efforlessly."
homepage = "https://loro.dev"
repository = "https://github.com/loro-dev/loro/"
authors = ["Zixuan Chen", "Liang Zhao"]
categories = []
keywords = ["crdt", "local-first"]

[dependencies]
enum-as-inner = "0.6.0"
rustc-hash = "2.1.1"
[dependencies.loro-internal]
path = "../loro-internal"
version = "1.10.3"

[dependencies.loro-common]
path = "../loro-common"
version = "1.10.0"
features = ["serde_json"]

[dependencies.loro-kv-store]
path = "../kv-store"
version = "1.10.0"

[dependencies.delta]
path = "../delta"
package = "loro-delta"
version = "1.9.1"

[dependencies.generic-btree]
version = "^0.10.7"

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1"

[dev-dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.83"
ctor = "0.2"
rand = "0.8.5"
pretty_assertions = "1.4.0"
loom = "0.7"
base64 = "0.22.1"
serial_test = "3"
[dev-dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1.0.87"
features = ["float_roundtrip"]

[dev-dependencies.dev-utils]
path = "../dev-utils"

[features]
default = ["counter"]
counter = ["loro-internal/counter"]
jsonpath = ["loro-internal/jsonpath"]
logging = ["loro-internal/logging"]

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(loom)"]

[package]
name = "loro-common"
version = "1.10.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
description = "Common types and functions for Loro. This is an internal lib of Loro."
documentation = "https://docs.rs/loro/"
homepage = "https://loro.dev"
repository = "https://github.com/loro-dev/loro"
authors = ["Zixuan Chen", "Liang Zhao"]
categories = []
keywords = ["crdt", "local-first"]

[dependencies]
serde = "1"
thiserror = "1.0.43"
rustc-hash = "2.1.1"
enum-as-inner = "0.6.0"
nonmax = "0.5.5"
leb128 = "0.2.5"
[dependencies.rle]
path = "../rle"
version = "1.6.0"
package = "loro-rle"

[dependencies.serde_json]
optional = true
version = "1.0"

[dependencies.wasm-bindgen]
version = "=0.2.100"
optional = true

[dependencies.arbitrary]
version = "1.3.0"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.js-sys]
version = "0.3.60"
optional = true

[dependencies.serde_columnar]
version = "0.3.14"

[dependencies.tracing]
optional = true
version = "0.1"

[features]
wasm = ["wasm-bindgen", "js-sys"]
logging = ["tracing"]
counter = []

[package]
name = "loro-delta"
version = "1.9.1"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
description = "Loro internal library. It's used as a delta between two versions of text or lists. It's also an efficient Rope."
homepage = "https://loro.dev"
repository = "https://github.com/loro-dev/loro/"
authors = ["Zixuan Chen", "Liang Zhao"]
categories = ["data-structures"]
keywords = ["rope"]

[dependencies]
arrayvec = "0.7.4"
heapless = "0.8.0"
enum-as-inner = "0.5.1"

[dependencies.generic-btree]
version = "^0.10.7"

[dev-dependencies]
tracing = "0.1.40"
tracing-subscriber = "0.3.18"
color-backtrace = "0.6.1"
ctor = "0.2"

[dev-dependencies.criterion]
version = "0.4"
features = ["html_reports"]

[dev-dependencies.rand]
version = "0.8.5"

[[bench]]
name = "rope"
harness = false

[package]
name = "loro-internal"
version = "1.10.3"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
description = "Loro internal library. Do not use it directly as it's not stable."
documentation = "https://docs.rs/loro/"
homepage = "https://loro.dev"
repository = "https://github.com/loro-dev/loro/"
authors = ["Zixuan Chen", "Liang Zhao"]
categories = []
keywords = ["crdt", "local-first"]

[dependencies]
rustc-hash = "2.1.1"
serde = "1"
thiserror = "1"
enum-as-inner = "0.6.0"
serde_json = "1.0"
bytes = "1"
itertools = "0.12.1"
enum_dispatch = "0.3.11"
once_cell = "1.18.0"
num = "0.4.0"
getrandom = "0.2.15"
leb128 = "0.2.5"
num-traits = "0.2"
either = "1"
md5 = "0.7.0"
arref = "0.1.0"
nonmax = "0.5.5"
ensure-cov = "0.1.0"
pretty_assertions = "1.4.1"
thread_local = "1.1.8"
parking_lot = "0.12.5"
pest = "2.8.3"
pest_derive = "2.8.3"
[dependencies.generic-btree]
version = "^0.10.7"

[dependencies.smallvec]
version = "1.8.0"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.loro-delta]
path = "../delta"
version = "1.9.1"
package = "loro-delta"

[dependencies.rle]
path = "../rle"
version = "1.6.0"
package = "loro-rle"

[dependencies.loro-common]
path = "../loro-common"
version = "1.10.0"

[dependencies.fractional_index]
path = "../fractional_index"
features = ["serde"]
version = "1.6.0"
package = "loro_fractional_index"

[dependencies.loro-kv-store]
path = "../kv-store"
version = "1.10.0"

[dependencies.xxhash-rust]
version = "0.8.12"
features = ["xxh32"]

[dependencies.serde_columnar]
version = "0.3.14"

[dependencies.arbitrary]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.postcard]
version = "1"
features = ["use-std"]

[dependencies.append-only-bytes]
version = "0.1.12"
features = ["u32_range"]

[dependencies.im]
version = "15.1.0"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.tabled]
version = "0.10.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.wasm-bindgen]
version = "=0.2.100"
optional = true

[dependencies.js-sys]
version = "0.3.60"
optional = true

[dependencies.rand]
version = "0.8.5"

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1"

[target]
[target."cfg(loom)".dependencies.loom]
version = "0.7"
features = ["checkpoint"]

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.getrandom]
version = "0.2.15"
features = ["js"]

[target."cfg(all(target_arch = \"wasm32\", not(features = \"wasm\")))".dependencies]
wasm-bindgen = "0.2.100"

[lints.rust.unexpected_cfgs]
level = "warn"
check-cfg = ["cfg(loom)"]

[dev-dependencies]
miniz_oxide = "0.7.1"
tabled = "0.10.0"
ctor = "0.1.23"
zstd = "0.13.0"
[dev-dependencies.arbitrary]
version = "1"

[dev-dependencies.rand]
version = "0.8.5"

[dev-dependencies.bench-utils]
path = "../bench-utils"

[dev-dependencies.dev-utils]
path = "../dev-utils"

[dev-dependencies.criterion]
version = "0.7.0"
features = ["html_reports"]

[lib]
doctest = false
bench = false

[features]
wasm = ["wasm-bindgen", "js-sys", "loro-common/wasm"]
test_utils = ["arbitrary", "tabled"]
counter = ["loro-common/counter"]
logging = ["loro-common/logging"]
jsonpath = []

[[bench]]
name = "text_r"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "list"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "encode"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "pending"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "event"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "map"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "tree"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "jsonpath"
harness = false

[package]
name = "loro-kv-store"
version = "1.10.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
description = "Key-value store component for Loro, a high-performance CRDTs framework"
homepage = "https://loro.dev"
repository = "https://github.com/loro-dev/loro/"
authors = ["Liang Zhao", "Zixuan Chen"]

[target]
[target."cfg(all(target_arch = \"wasm32\", target_os = \"unknown\"))".dependencies.quick_cache]
version = "0.6.2"
default-features = false

[target."cfg(not(all(target_arch = \"wasm32\", target_os = \"unknown\")))".dependencies.quick_cache]
version = "0.6.2"

[dependencies]
bytes = "1"
rustc-hash = "2.1.1"
once_cell = "1.18.0"
ensure-cov = "0.1.0"
[dependencies.loro-common]
path = "../loro-common"
version = "1.10.0"

[dependencies.lz4_flex]
version = "0.11"

[dependencies.xxhash-rust]
version = "0.8.12"
features = ["xxh32"]

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1"

[dev-dependencies]
rand = "0.8.5"
ctor = "0.2"

[dev-dependencies.dev-utils]
path = "../dev-utils"

[package]
name = "loro-rle"
version = "1.6.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
description = "A internal library of loro for storing and manipulating run-length encoded data. Do not use it directly."
documentation = "https://docs.rs/loro/"
homepage = "https://loro.dev"
repository = "https://github.com/loro-dev/loro/"
authors = ["Zixuan Chen", "Liang Zhao"]
categories = ["data-structures"]
keywords = ["crdt", "local-first"]

[dependencies]
num = "0.4.0"
[dependencies.smallvec]
version = "1.8.0"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.append-only-bytes]
version = "0.1.11"
features = ["u32_range"]

[dev-dependencies]
ctor = "0.1.23"
proptest = "1.0.0"
smartstring = "1.0.1"
rand = "0.8.5"
static_assertions = "1.1.0"

[features]
test_utils = []
wasm = []

[package]
name = "loro_fractional_index"
version = "1.6.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT"
description = "Fraction index for Loro. Fork and modified from jamsocket/fractional_index"
repository = "https://github.com/loro-dev/loro/"
authors = ["Liang Zhao", "Zixuan Chen"]
categories = []
keywords = ["crdt", "local-first"]

[dependencies]
once_cell = "1.18.0"
[dependencies.serde]
features = ["derive", "rc"]
optional = true
version = "1"

[dependencies.rand]
version = "^0.8"

[dev-dependencies]
criterion = "^0.5.0"
[dev-dependencies.fraction_index]
version = "^2.0"
package = "fractional_index"

[[bench]]
name = "fractional_index"
harness = false

[package]
name = "p2panda-core"
version = "0.5.1"
edition = "2024"
authors = ["adz <x12@adz.garden>", "sandreae <contact@samandreae.com>", "glyph <glyph@mycelial.technology>"]
description = "Extensible data-types for secure, distributed and efficient exchange of data"
repository = "https://github.com/p2panda/p2panda"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["p2p", "data-types", "blake3", "cbor", "ed25519"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true

[lints.rust]

[features]
default = ["prune"]
prune = []

[dependencies]
blake3 = "1.8.1"
ciborium = "0.2.2"
rand = "0.8.5"
thiserror = "2.0.12"
[dependencies.arbitrary]
version = "1.4.1"
optional = true
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.ed25519-dalek]
version = "2.1.1"
features = ["rand_core"]

[dependencies.hex]
version = "0.4.3"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.219"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.serde_bytes]
version = "0.11.17"

[dev-dependencies]
serde_json = "1.0.140"

[package]
name = "p2panda-discovery"
version = "0.5.1"
edition = "2024"
authors = ["adz <x12@adz.garden>", "jackaperkins <jackaperkins@posteo.net>"]
description = "Confidential topic and node discovery protocol"
repository = "https://github.com/p2panda/p2panda"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["p2p", "discovery", "confidential"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true

[lints.rust]

[features]
default = ["random_walk"]
random_walk = ["dep:rand", "dep:thiserror", "dep:tokio"]
test_utils = ["dep:rand", "dep:rand_chacha", "dep:thiserror"]

[dependencies]
blake3 = "1.8.2"

[dependencies.futures-util]
version = "0.3.31"
features = ["sink"]
default-features = false

[dependencies.rand]
version = "0.9.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.rand_chacha]
version = "0.9.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.228"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.thiserror]
version = "2.0.17"
optional = true

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.48.0"
features = ["sync"]
optional = true
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies]
rand = "0.9.0"
rand_chacha = "0.9.0"
[dev-dependencies.futures-channel]
version = "0.3.31"
features = ["sink"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.48.0"
features = ["macros", "rt", "sync"]

[package]
name = "p2panda-net"
version = "0.5.1"
edition = "2024"
authors = ["adz <x12@adz.garden>", "sandreae <contact@samandreae.com>", "glyph <glyph@mycelial.technology>"]
description = "Data-type-agnostic p2p networking, discovery, gossip and local-first sync"
repository = "https://github.com/p2panda/p2panda"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["p2p", "local-first", "sync", "gossip", "discovery"]

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true

[lints.rust]

[features]
default = ["address_book", "iroh_endpoint", "iroh_mdns", "discovery", "gossip", "sync"]
address_book = ["dep:p2panda-store"]
iroh_endpoint = ["address_book", "dep:iroh", "dep:iroh-base"]
iroh_mdns = ["iroh_endpoint", "iroh/address-lookup-mdns"]
discovery = ["address_book", "iroh_endpoint", "dep:p2panda-discovery"]
gossip = ["address_book", "iroh_endpoint", "dep:iroh-gossip"]
sync = ["address_book", "iroh_endpoint", "gossip", "dep:p2panda-store", "dep:p2panda-sync"]
supervisor = []
test_utils = ["dep:tracing-subscriber"]

[dependencies]
ciborium = "0.2.2"
futures-channel = "0.3.31"
futures-util = "0.3.31"
hex = "0.4.3"
ractor = "0.15.8"
rand = "0.9.2"
rand_chacha = "0.9.0"
thiserror = "2.0.17"
tracing = "0.1.41"

[dependencies.iroh]
version = "0.96.1"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.iroh-base]
version = "0.96.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.iroh-gossip]
version = "0.96.0"
optional = true

[dependencies.p2panda-core]
path = "../p2panda-core"
version = "0.5.1"

[dependencies.p2panda-discovery]
path = "../p2panda-discovery"
version = "0.5.1"
features = ["test_utils"]
optional = true

[dependencies.p2panda-store]
path = "../p2panda-store"
version = "0.5.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.p2panda-sync]
path = "../p2panda-sync"
version = "0.5.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.219"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.47.1"
features = ["rt", "sync"]

[dependencies.tokio-stream]
version = "0.1.17"
features = ["sync"]

[dependencies.tokio-util]
version = "0.7.16"
features = ["codec", "compat"]

[dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
version = "0.3.20"
features = ["env-filter"]
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.100"
assert_matches = "1.5.0"
futures-test = "0.3.31"
mock_instant = "0.6.0"

[dev-dependencies.clap]
version = "4.5.54"
features = ["derive"]

[dev-dependencies.p2panda-net]
path = "."
features = ["test_utils"]

[dev-dependencies.p2panda-sync]
path = "../p2panda-sync"
features = ["test_utils"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.47.1"
features = ["rt", "sync", "time"]

[dev-dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
version = "0.3.20"
features = ["env-filter"]

[package]
name = "p2panda-store"
version = "0.5.1"
edition = "2024"
authors = ["adz <x12@adz.garden>", "sandreae <contact@samandreae.com>", "glyph <glyph@mycelial.technology>"]
description = "Store traits and implementations"
repository = "https://github.com/p2panda/p2panda"

[dependencies.hex]
version = "0.4.3"
optional = true

[dependencies.p2panda-core]

version = "0.5.1"

[dependencies.rand]
version = "0.8.5"
optional = true

[dependencies.sqlx]

[dev-dependencies]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/loro-dev/loro"]

[source."https://github.com/p2panda/p2panda"]

rev = "a1308c116c1bd345f2cd6af7df41d2a6e0a4a682"
